seo.title: EPC Rovinj — Church with a Pulse
seo.description: Pentecostal church in Rovinj, Croatia. A living community of faith, prayer and the Holy Spirit. Join us Sundays at 10:00 AM.

common.coming_soon_body: This page is in the works. We'll be back with more soon.

hero.subtitle: Sunday worship, honest prayer, Scripture, and a community that opens its arms before it asks anything of you.
hero.side_title: No performance. No pressure. Space to breathe, belong, and seek God.
hero.image_alt: View of Rovinj old town by the sea

beliefs_intro.title: A faith that breathes, a community that lives
beliefs_intro.body: We believe God is alive, Jesus Christ is Saviour, and the Holy Spirit still moves in our lives today. We are a Pentecostal church — rooted in the Bible, open to the Spirit, devoted to one another and to the city of Rovinj.

map_callout.title: You'll find us in the heart of Rovinj
map_callout.body: Open doors every Sunday. Easy parking, short walk from the waterfront.

hero.title: A church with a pulse — in Rovinj since 2009
hero.subtitle: Our story is the story of God's faithfulness — from a small prayer group to a living church family.

history.title: Our story
history.body_1: EPC Rovinj grew out of a prayer group meeting in homes in the early 2000s. With a desire for Rovinj to have a living Pentecostal community, we were officially registered as a church in 2009.
history.body_2: Over the years we've grown as a family — baptisms in the sea, summer conferences, home groups across town, and a warm welcome for everyone who walks through our doors.
history.body_3: Today we gather in our space on Istarska street, but the heart of the church is still the people — locals and visitors who've found a spiritual home.

beliefs.title: What we believe
beliefs.intro: We stand on the Holy Scriptures and on the classic Christian faith expressed in the Apostles' Creed, with a Pentecostal emphasis on the work of the Holy Spirit.

bible.title: The Bible
bible.body: We believe the Bible is the inspired Word of God, authoritative for faith and life.

god.title: The triune God
god.body: We believe in one God — Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

jesus.title: Jesus Christ
jesus.body: We believe Jesus Christ is the Son of God, Saviour of the world, who died, rose, and lives.

salvation.title: Salvation
salvation.body: Salvation is a gift of grace, received by faith in Jesus Christ — not by works.

spirit.title: Baptism in the Holy Spirit
spirit.body: We believe in the baptism in the Holy Spirit, empowering the believer for life and service.

gifts.title: Gifts of the Spirit
gifts.body: We believe the Holy Spirit still gives gifts today — prophecy, tongues, healing, service — for the building up of the Church.

church.title: The Church
church.body: The Church is the body of Christ — a community of believers called to fellowship, worship, and mission.

return.title: Christ's return
return.body: We look forward to the soon and personal return of Jesus Christ for His Church.

mission.title: Vision and mission
mission.vision_body: To be a church with a pulse in Rovinj — alive, warm, accessible, and open to anyone seeking God.
mission.mission_body: To proclaim the gospel of Jesus Christ, to disciple believers into the life of Christ, and to lovingly serve the city of Rovinj through prayer, the Word, and concrete acts of care.

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.subtitle: A team that cares for the community and walks before God in prayer.

bios.pastor_ivan: Ivan has led EPC Rovinj since 2012. A passionate preacher of the Word and a shepherd with an open heart for the city.
bios.elder_marko: Marko serves as elder and teacher — leading Bible studies and mentoring younger men.
bios.worship_lead_ana: Ana leads the worship team and Sunday services — she believes praise opens heaven.
bios.youth_lead_petar: Petar is with the youth all week — from Friday nights to summer beach hangouts.

hero.title: When we gather
hero.subtitle: The weekly rhythm of our church and special events through the year — all in one place.

schedule.events_subtitle: Conferences, baptisms, worship nights, and seminars.

sunday_service.title: Sunday service
sunday_service.description: Our main weekly gathering — worship, preaching, prayer, and fellowship. Open to everyone.

prayer_meeting.title: Prayer meeting
prayer_meeting.description: An open hour of prayer for the city, the church, and personal needs.

bible_study.title: Bible study
bible_study.description: Walking through books of Scripture — questions, discussion, application.

youth_group.title: Youth group
youth_group.description: Teens and young adults up to 25 — worship, teaching, hangouts, games.

home_groups.title: Home groups
home_groups.description: Small groups meeting in homes — where the church becomes family.

baptism_service.title: Baptism in the sea
baptism_service.description: Public baptism of believers — a celebration of new faith with song, testimonies, and a picnic to follow.

summer_conference.title: Summer Conference 'Pulse 2026'
summer_conference.description: Three days together — guest preachers, worship, healing services, and workshops.

worship_night.title: Worship night
worship_night.description: Open to everyone — ninety minutes of worship, prayer, and quiet rest before God.

kids_camp.title: Kids camp
kids_camp.description: Five days of fun, Bible stories, and friendships — for kids ages 7 to 12.

hero.title: Sermons
hero.subtitle: Archive of Sunday sermons — listen, watch, share.

filters.no_results: No results for the selected filters.

sto_je_moj_poziv.title: What Is My Calling
sto_je_moj_poziv.summary: Who am I, where am I going, and what does God expect of me — a sermon on discovering and living your calling.

nova_sansa.title: A New Chance
nova_sansa.summary: God is the God of new beginnings. A sermon on how His grace opens doors we thought were closed forever.

ne_ide_vise_ovako.title: This Can't Go On
ne_ide_vise_ovako.summary: A moment of honest confrontation with what isn't working — and an invitation to turn back to God.

lav_i_janje.title: The Lion and the Lamb
lav_i_janje.summary: Jesus is both Lion and Lamb — the reigning Lord and the sacrificed Saviour. A sermon on Christ's authority and His sacrifice.

nemoguci_problem.title: The Impossible Problem
nemoguci_problem.summary: When the problem is bigger than any solution — a sermon on where to look for help when our own strength runs out.

dva_tri_najteza_dana.title: 2 – 3 Hardest Days
dva_tri_najteza_dana.summary: A sermon about the hardest days of life — and what happens when God stays with us through them.

modern_pioneer_ii.title: Modern Pioneer Part II
modern_pioneer_ii.summary: Continuation of a sermon on the life of a faith pioneer in the modern world — courage, vision, and commitment to the call.

tko_ima_i_tko_nema.title: Have and Have Not
tko_ima_i_tko_nema.summary: Jesus' principles on giving and receiving, wealth and need — and how those who have are called to live before God.

o_obaziranju_nazad.title: Looking Back and Looking Forward
o_obaziranju_nazad.summary: The lesson of Lot's wife and God's invitation to all who are held captive by the past — let go and move forward.

oslobadajuce_svjetlo.title: Liberating Light
oslobadajuce_svjetlo.summary: A sermon on Jesus' declaration 'I am the light of the world' — and the freedom that comes from truly seeing ourselves and God.

ev_mateju_18_15.title: Matthew 18:15
ev_mateju_18_15.summary: Jesus' instruction for resolving conflict in the community — practical application of biblical reconciliation in church and relationships.

kampiranje_na_bozjem_ognistu.title: Camping at God's Hearth
kampiranje_na_bozjem_ognistu.summary: A sermon about dwelling continuously in God's presence — prayer, praise, and daily fellowship with God.

istinska_zrtva.title: The True Sacrifice
istinska_zrtva.summary: What God truly asks of us — a sermon on the difference between religious performance and living faith expressed in surrender.

skola_pustinje.title: School of the Desert
skola_pustinje.summary: The desert is not punishment — it is God's school. A sermon on what God teaches His people in seasons of waiting and silence.

marija_i_navjestenje.title: Mary and the Annunciation
marija_i_navjestenje.summary: A sermon on Mary's faith and obedience to God's call — a message for all who find themselves before an unexpected plan of God.

test_u_pustinji.title: Test in the Desert
test_u_pustinji.summary: Temptations are not random — God allows tests that reveal who we are and strengthen what we are. A sermon on Jesus' temptations.

bdijte_da_ne_padnete.title: Watch and Pray
bdijte_da_ne_padnete.summary: Jesus' call to the apostles in Gethsemane: watch and pray. A sermon on spiritual alertness and a life of prayer.

usi_koje_cuju.title: Ears That Hear, Eyes That See
usi_koje_cuju.summary: A sermon on spiritual sensitivity — why some hear God's voice and others don't, and how to cultivate a heart that recognises God.

proklamiranje_evandjelja.title: Proclaiming the Gospel
proklamiranje_evandjelja.summary: The church is not called to guard the gospel — but to proclaim it. A sermon on courage and the call to witness.

ne_sramim_se_evandjelja.title: Not Ashamed of the Gospel
ne_sramim_se_evandjelja.summary: Paul's bold declaration from Romans 1:16 — and what it means to carry the gospel with pride and without shame today.

rimljanima_poslanica.title: Paul's Letter to the Romans
rimljanima_poslanica.summary: A sermon from Paul's letter to the Romans — on God's righteousness, faith, and the power of the gospel for all who believe.

sira_slika.title: The Bigger Picture
sira_slika.summary: When we can't see the meaning in what we're going through, God sees the bigger picture. A sermon on trusting the God who holds everything.

znas_li_sta_imas.title: Do You Know What You Have?
znas_li_sta_imas.summary: A sermon on the wealth of our spiritual inheritance in Christ — and how believers often live below the level of what has been given to them.

kako_primas.title: How You Receive
kako_primas.summary: The posture of the heart before God determines how much we receive from Him — and why sometimes we receive nothing at all.

hero.title: Ways we serve, and how you can get involved
hero.subtitle: The church is a family that builds together. These are the teams through which we do it.

children.title: Children's program
children.description: During Sunday service, kids have their own age-appropriate program — Bible, creative activities, and play.

youth.title: Youth
youth.description: Teens and young adults gather on Fridays — worship, conversations about faith and life, hangouts.

home_groups.title: Home groups
home_groups.description: Smaller groups meeting in homes — Bible study, prayer, and authentic fellowship.

worship.title: Worship team
worship.description: Musicians and singers who lead the church in worship on Sundays and special events.

evangelism.title: Evangelism
evangelism.description: Practical sharing of the good news in our city — street outreaches, creative events, summer missions.

social.title: Social and humanitarian work
social.description: Concrete love for the city — helping families in need, partnering with local initiatives.

hero.title: Get in touch
hero.subtitle: Whether you have a question, want to visit, or just want to talk — we're here.

footer.about_blurb: A Pentecostal church in the heart of Rovinj. Open doors for everyone — believers, seekers, and visitors.
